   MMINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  ART IN PUBLIC PLACES COMMITTEE
  July 22, 2024

Chair Le Gaspi called the meeting to order at 5:32 p.m. at Norwalk City Hall, Conference
Room 4, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll call were
Committee Members Apodaca, Juan, Lopez, and Solis and Chair Le Gaspi. Committee
Member Stefenhagen was absent. Theresa Devoy, Staff Liaison and Camille Moreno,
Assistant City Clerk were also present.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Member Juan moved and Member Solis seconded to approve the minutes of March 26, 2024.
MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Members Apodaca, Juan, Lopez, Solis, and Chair Le Gaspi
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  Member Stefenhagen

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTIONS

Staff held the annual elections for the position of Chair and Vice Chair. Chair Le Gaspi moved
and Member Apodaca seconded to nominate Member Juan for the position of Chair and all
Members voted in favor. Chair Juan moved and Member Le Gaspi seconded to nominate
Member Apodaca for Vice Chair and all Members voted in favor of the nomination. The newly
elected Chair and Vice Chair are Juan and Apodaca, respectively.

REPORTS

Aquatic Center Community Mosaic Project Update

Ms. Devoy shared that the artist purchased all tiles and would begin working on the mosaic
offsite, and that she would be onsite beginning in September so as to not interfere with swim
lessons. She also indicated the City will advertise for participants to help place mosaic tiles on
the boards prior to installation. RECEIVE AND FILE.

Milagro Art

Ms. Devoy highlighted the Norwalk Municipal Code (NMC) regarding the criteria for art projects
such as: business to provide an art installation or in-lieu contribution for development/
remodels, art shall be placed in a public place, conforms to the approved themes, does not
promote the business, and is not mass produced. Ms. Devoy showed the proposed design
which consists of an inside mural entitled “A Father’s Gift”, the word “Milagro” painted on the
outside, and an art hallway inside the cinema. She indicated Mr. Esparza requested his initial
in-lieu contribution of $20,000 be refunded and also that the City contribute an additional
$20,000 to pay for the proposed artwork. Committee Member discussion ensued. Members
Le Gaspi and Apodaca shared concerns regarding public access and the artwork displaying
“Milagro” which depicts the name of the theater.

Mr. Esparza stated that the request is for a total of $50,000, the lobby will be open to the public
for over 10 hours each day and that the word Milagro is a cultural concept and not meant to
represent the name of the theater. Member Solis moved and Member Lopez seconded to
approve the funding in the amount of $50,000 and the artwork as submitted. MOTION
CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Members Lopez and Solis, and Chair Juan
NOES:  Member Le Gaspi and Vice Chair Apodaca
ABSENT:  Member Stefenhagen

COMMENTS FROM STAFF

Ms. Devoy shared she is working on the proposal for the Cultural Art Center near Sproul Street
and Clarkdale Avenue.

COMMENTS FROM COMMITTEE MEMBERS

Vice Chair Apodoca requested a report on what the balance of the Art in Public Places account
is. Member Solis requested an update regarding the utility box near the Social Services Center
off Alondra.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

Caren Spilsbury thanked the Committee for approving the Milagro Theater project.

ADJOURNMENT

The meeting was adjourned at 6:36 p.m.

________________________________
Victor Juan, Chair
